events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the tragic death of influential rapper Tupac Shakur.

angles.name: Legacy of a Legend
angles.copy: Twenty-nine years ago, the music world lost a true icon. Tupac Shakur's impact continues to resonate.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road at 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Timeless Crossing
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and inspiring generations with her incredible voice and songwriting.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, the world lost a true musical pioneer. Jimi Hendrix's revolutionary guitar playing continues to inspire.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine (UK Single) Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: A Song For Peace
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' hit the airwaves in the UK. Its message of peace and unity is as relevant as ever.

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple changed personal music forever. What was your first MP3 player?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the 1962 premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 007 first graced the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring music and message of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Sending happy 87th birthday wishes to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album at 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double LP
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. So many diverse tracks, what's your standout?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost one of the greatest showmen in music history. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul at 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Folk-Rock Masterpiece
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' shifted the sound of pop. A truly influential album.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the tragic death of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Peace and Music
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world mourned the loss of John Lennon. His message of peace and incredible music live on.
